/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json,re
path='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/APPLE_2015_10K_reconstructed.json'
with open(path) as f:
    data=json.load(f)['texts']
patterns=['CONSOLIDATED STATEMENTS OF OPERATIONS','Statement of Operations','Income Statement','Net sales','Total revenue','Revenue']
for p in patterns:
    print('\\nPATTERN',p)
    for i,t in enumerate(data):
        txt=' '.join(t.get('text','').split())
        if p.lower() in txt.lower():
            print('idx',i,'page',t.get('page_no'),'text',txt[:300])
            break
PY"

item.text: I found the audited consolidated statements section. Next I’m pulling the actual line items from the income statement page to get the latest year’s revenue figure.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json
path='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/APPLE_2015_10K_reconstructed.json'
texts=json.load(open(path))['texts']
# print all texts on page 41 (income statement page)
for i,t in enumerate(texts):
    if t.get('page_no')==41:
        txt=' '.join(t.get('text','').split())
        print('IDX',i,'LABEL',t.get('label'),'STRUCT',t.get('structure'))
        print(txt)
        print('---')
PY"
